Name: (CP) Earthy Medieval and VPR Style SVE Farm Buildings (Stardew Valley Expanded)
Author: SeaSea50
Description:
[center][/center]
[center][img]https://i.ibb.co/ZxMrNps/mod-details-1.png[/img]

The newly added buildings in SVE's 1.15 update currently don't have any retexture mod just yet; so I created this recolour!

There's two variations for the coop: Normal and Darker

You can enable/disable any sprite using the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿.

For the 2.0.0 update I took inspiration from Firefly's repainted models from the #farm-layouts channel in the SVE discord who used my models as a base.

Let me know if there's any bugs, or if you'd like me to add anything.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/JtMTbjw/installation.png<img src=[/img]

This is a Content Patcher mod so it goes in your mods folder to work. Here's a step by step process:
 
[list=1]
[*]Download and unzip this mod into your mods folder

[/*]
[*]You're all done!

[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/HtmBT4b/compatibility-1.png[/img][/url]

Should work with any recolour or retexture :)


[img]https://i.ibb.co/y0bTYfR/credits.png[/img][/*]
[/list]
Inspired by the colour palette's of  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Recolor[/url]﻿ & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23095]Slow Soft Seasons[/url]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22350]
[/url]
Thank you Flashshifter and the rest of the SVE team for the open asset use permission. Couldn't have made this without the mod :) Checkout the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Main Mod[/url]﻿!

Can't forget to thank ConcernedApe for making Stardew Valley[/center]
